name: US–China / Taiwan
value: Fujian landing drill under way 27 Nov
summary: China's amphibious drill in Fujian's Dacheng Bay still under way on 27 Nov; US tariff proposal on 25 Nov
state: Reuters reported on 27 Nov that a Chinese amphibious drill in Dacheng Bay, Fujian, about 280km from Taiwan, has been running since 1 Nov, with landing craft and civilian vessels building a floating bridge; China's defence ministry called it legitimate and Taiwan said it is weighing the implications (Taipei Times). On 25 Nov the US proposed Section 301 tariffs of up to 20% on China (USTR). No blockade or clash found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Tension around Taiwan matters for supply chains in electronics and semiconductors. Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice for Taiwan and China.
rubric_hit: Large-scale PLA exercise and new US trade measures = Watch; no blockade or clash

sources.title: Taipei Times — China tests landing tactics in drills

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
